author: Partner Threat Feed
attributes.description: Identifies processes started from binaries whose SHA-256 hash matches a Saffron Mallet botnet sample, as reported in campaign PTF-02529. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.
false_positives: Security testing that replays known indicators.
A shared hosting address or domain that later served benign content.
attributes.name: Saffron Mallet Botnet: Process started from known malicious binary (PTF-02529)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Saffron Mallet Botnet: Process started from known malicious binary

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Saffron Mallet botnet in campaign PTF-02529.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
